name: comp-389
title: Anchored Product Tour
description: A grid of four numbered cards sits above a Start tour button. Starting opens a popover beside the current card with a step title, description, a counter and a Next link that moves to the following card.
use: New users need a short guided walkthrough of a few areas on a screen.
avoid: The four cards are plain numbered boxes, so the tour points at stand-ins rather than real UI.
a11y: Start tour and Next are real buttons, but the numbered cards are plain divs with no labels tying them to steps. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four small numbered tiles in a two-by-two grid sit above an outlined Start tour button on a near-black page. The tour popover is a dark card with an arrow, a bold step name, a few lines of grey text, a '1/4' counter and a Next link.
behaves: Clicking Start tour opens the popover beside card one and resets to the first step. Next advances the highlight and the popover to the next card; on the last step the link becomes Start over.
customise: The four step titles, descriptions, icons and the numbered cards are fixed in the file; adapting the tour means editing those arrays.
weight: light: Four static cards and one small popover; no animation loop.
demo: Cards numbered 1 to 4; tour steps Heart, Diamond, Club and Spade with placeholder workspace copy.
issues: The tour points at plain numbered boxes instead of real interface elements.
The active step is not announced to screen readers beyond the popover text.
polishWhy: Clear little tour; the stand-in numbered cards make it feel like a demo.
